summary.text: Anthony Brown is the incumbent Democratic Attorney General of Maryland, seeking a second term. A Harvard-educated lawyer and Army veteran, he previously served in the Maryland House of Delegates, as lieutenant governor under Gov. Martin O'Malley, and for three terms in the U.S. House before taking office as attorney general in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Served in the U.S. Army as an aviation officer (1984-1989) and in the U.S. Army Reserve; earned an A.B. (1984) and J.D. (1992) from Harvard University, per the Maryland Manual.
Served in the Maryland House of Delegates (1999-2007), as Lieutenant Governor of Maryland (2007-2015), and in the U.S. House of Representatives for Maryland's 4th District (2017-2023).
